passages.note: House roll call 70, 3rd reading of HJR 3; Thompson is in the Yea column.

passages.provision_quote: Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: HJR 3's new Section 38 bars recognition of any marriage but one man/one woman; no civil-union clause is named.

rows.reasoning: Thompson voted Yea on HJR 3 (2014) (roll call 70, 3rd reading), a single-subject joint resolution whose added Section 38 states that only a marriage between one man and one woman is valid or recognized in Indiana, barring recognition of same-sex marriage and defining marriage as one man and one woman with no civil-union clause. This matches rung 5, 'Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman.'
